imageChecks.review: 語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A family cuts a whole birthday cake; a child takes only one small slice while the remaining cake is clearly visible. Show a part of a whole through a real scene.
語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child opens curtains and marvels at a garden entirely covered by fresh snow, from foreground to horizon; a whole surface blanketed with snow.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Close view of a child holding up exactly one index finger with the other four fingers folded, counting one. Entire hand visible, anatomically correct, not pointing at a distant object.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child on a bicycle completes one circuit of a circular park path, returning to the same starting bench where a parent waves. Path is visible as one continuous loop in a real park.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A friendly forensic investigator kneels by a footprint in mud and holds a shoe beside it; distinctive zigzag sole exactly matches the muddy impression. Magnifying glass, no crime or distress.
語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A grandparent and child watch a pendulum clock. Pendulum shown at evenly spaced swing positions with a small unobtrusive arc; steady rhythm at home, no disconnected diagram.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Two clear narrative halves: left a child pulls a sweet-potato vine and several attached tubers emerge successively from soil; right a friendly investigator follows connected clues from one photo to another to solve a harmless mystery. Show literal vine and metaphor of linked discoveries, no words.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child reluctantly tidies scattered toys after a parent asks. Child IS doing the task, putting a block in a box, shoulders slumped, downturned mouth, unhappy but accepting; no refusal gesture.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A friendly neighborhood inventor repairs a toy and builds a small wind-powered device in a garage. Neighbors point to him with admiring smiles and a shared speech bubble containing the short Japanese nickname「町の発明家」. Explain a common nickname people use, not a formal title; only this exact legible text.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Three connected real-life views: a child marks a meeting spot on a map with a red mark; adult holds a carved name seal; the seal presses red ink onto paper leaving a clear stamp impression. Include physical seal and printed mark, no extra text.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Beautiful outer-space scene of two spherical stars or planets in the same starry sky with soft mutual attraction lines, drifting slightly toward each other; small spaceship observes. Both bodies attract each other. No instructional labels or atom diagram.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child has just broken a blue vase with a ball. Nearby lies the ball and broken vase. Child points at an innocent seated cat and makes a speech bubble clearly showing that same CAT pushing the same vase, a false claim. Actual cat peaceful, adult skeptical.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A boy repeatedly boasts unbelievable lies to skeptical friends: three speech bubbles show himself flying without wings, lifting a huge elephant, and riding a fish through the sky. Bubbles clearly show the same boy, exaggerated fanciful claims.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A tired adult with an unmistakably vacant hollow expression sits looking into an empty cup: unfocused eyes, drooping posture, no smile, distracted gaze. A visibly empty open box nearby connects literal emptiness and emotional vacancy. Gentle, not frightening.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A rescue crew rapidly changes its plan when a road is blocked by a fallen branch: one member points to an alternative route on a map, another immediately deploys a small nimble rescue vehicle toward the alternate path. Dynamic responsive action, safe scene, no ordinary car-driving lesson.
語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child planting trees looks up at an enormous mature tree beside a tiny new sapling. Human scale and natural setting make large height and breadth unmistakable.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Two children measure the height and width of a cardboard box with a tape measure before choosing a box that fits a shelf. Clearly show measuring dimensions in a real packing scene.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A spirited GIRL with pigtails wearing shorts energetically climbs low playground climbing bars; cheerful active pose and playful muddy knees, a parent watches safely nearby. No boy as main subject.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Two toy robots clean the same floor. A shiny robot moves quickly and has finished its neat clean area; a battered older robot crawls slowly with a visibly unfinished area, loose panel and small wobble marks. Compare machine performance, no human humiliation.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child opens a gift and is visibly startled: eyes very wide, eyebrows lifted high, mouth open in a round O, torso recoils, both hands lifted. A harmless toy springs from the gift, strong surprised expression, no smile.
空の皿の前でお腹を押さえ、つらそうに待つ表情を確認。お腹の空くと空腹を共有。

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child sits upright IN BED in pajamas, suddenly realizing they overslept. Shocked worried face looks at an alarm clock showing late morning, bright sun through window, school bag by bed. Not a child arriving at school.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Three children at one art table each work on their own distinct drawing with their own crayons; one draws flowers, one a boat, one a cat. Each individual acts separately in a shared believable scene.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A parent tells a story aloud to two children seated nearby; mouth visibly speaking, friendly listening faces, a speech bubble shows a simple fairy-tale castle. No letters, envelopes, cards or written communication.
水中で苦しそうな子と、岸から引き上げる救助者を同じ画像に含め、溺れる・救うの両方に合う。

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A shop counter with a large main chocolate bar and its wrapper; a tiny inexpensive plastic toy car in a separate little transparent bonus packet attached to the chocolate package. Child delighted by the small extra toy, chocolate visibly main purchase.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A girl steps DOWN from a stationary bus onto a pavement, one foot firmly on sidewalk, the other on the lower bus step; handrail held, whole body and correctly formed feet visible. Bus door and steps coherent.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A sunny farm with flourishing vegetables, a gentle irrigation stream and family enjoying the harvest. Sunlight, water and fertile soil visibly bring benefit; emphasize gifts of nature, not a person handing a gift.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A clever child solves how to cross a puddle without wet feet: places several stable stepping stones and tests the path carefully while a friend watches admiringly. Clear planning and good judgment, no adult cleaning a mess.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Close view of a child biting directly into a large whole red apple, front teeth visibly meeting apple skin; apple much larger than one mouthful, small fresh bite mark. Not eating with a spoon.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child counts six apples one by one, index finger touching the next apple while the other hand records tally marks on paper. All apples and counting person visible, no abstract row of dots.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child opens a lunch box expecting lunch but finds it completely empty, looks puzzled and tips lid open toward viewer; companion starts offering a sandwich. Show an empty container as part of a story, not a labeled diagram.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child tilts a transparent cookie jar upside down after all cookies were eaten; absolutely nothing comes out. Surprised disappointed face, a few crumbs on table, jar clearly empty.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A family moves into a rented small house: landlord gives keys, moving boxes and modest sofa visible, family begins daily life inside. House on loan for living, not a child borrowing stationery.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: School event: a temporary reception desk made from a folding table and simple canopy stands in front of a permanent school entrance. Volunteers set it up and stack folding chairs, unmistakably temporary provisional setup.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Fairy-tale princess at a ball under a short-lived magic spell: a clock approaches midnight, sparkling dress begins reverting into plain clothes at the hem and magical carriage fades toward a pumpkin outside. Transient condition, original storybook design, not a branded character.
語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: An adorable small fluffy puppy tilts its head, round gentle eyes, tiny paws, soft ears; a child crouches nearby smiling fondly. Puppy is the main subject.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Five clearly separated vignettes of the same child: sees a colorful flower with eyes; listens to a ringing bell with ear; smells a flower with nose; tastes a strawberry with tongue; touches soft fabric with hand. All five senses explicitly visible, no labels.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Children plant seedlings in a garden bed, using a small ruler to leave equal gaps between the plants. Main action is checking the distance between neighboring seedlings, real garden context.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Two equal narrative halves: left a worker strikes a metal bell repeatedly with a small mallet, clear ringing vibration marks; right an angry child with furrowed brows, tight mouth and fists after a toy breaks. Show metallic ringing sound and intense anger, no text.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Two coherent halves: film director beside camera giving actors instructions on a film set; sports coach beside a soccer field holding tactics clipboard and instructing team. Both directing people, cinema and sports explicitly visible.
雨風の中で疲れながら歩き続ける場面は、艱難辛苦・堅忍・タフ・忍耐の苦労と耐える語義に共通する。

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: An office worker drafts a formal written proposal at a desk, several typed pages with neat headings and numbered sections, pen revising one page, computer and folder. Business documents are main focus, not models or childrens play.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Two friends plan a camping trip before leaving: study a paper calendar, map and checklist on a desk; a shared thought bubble shows tent and campsite they intend to visit. Plans on paper and in minds, not already building a model.
空気を閉じ込めたシャボン玉・炭酸の気泡・やかんの水蒸気の場面。白い湯気は気体そのものではない旨を説明に明記。

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Three distinct competitions in one coherent sports day collage: runners racing, children competing in a chess match, and two groups in a tug-of-war. Clearly broader competition beyond foot racing, friendly rivalry.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Three equally large connected scenes for Japanese civic duties: parent brings school-age child to a school gate (parent ensuring education); adult works in a workshop; adult pays tax at a government counter with a paper form and coins. No implying schoolchild has duty to work or pay taxes.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child opens a wooden matryoshka nesting doll into two halves, revealing its clearly hollow interior; smaller nesting doll sits beside it on table. Show actual inner cavity, not rectangular diagram.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child draws a colorful picture on paper but deliberately leaves a large white space for adding something later. Hand and colored crayons visible, the empty unmarked part of actual paper prominent, not an outlined answer box.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A pupil at desk looks at a test answer sheet with a numbered problem and an EMPTY rectangular answer field; holds pencil ready to fill it. Minimal clear numerals and simple arithmetic such as 2+3=, no large arbitrary text.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Two clear side-by-side poses of the same child performing ONLY knee bends: left upright with knees straight, right squat with knees bent and heels on ground, arms extended for balance. Simple arrow between poses, knees clearly visible, no forward bending or side stretching.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child at kitchen table sorts red apples into one basket and green pear-shaped pears into a different basket after inspecting their shapes. Two types distinctly separated, no buttons.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: An engineer at a control console urgently identifies a critical red flashing warning beside a dam water-level display and presses a safety control, another operator responds immediately. Serious pivotal situation with calm problem-solving, no animal fight, no disaster victims.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: A child returns to their own home after school, stepping IN through the open front door with a schoolbag; parent inside welcomes child, shoes being removed at entry, familiar slippers waiting. Direction clearly toward home, not leaving home.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: An adult has firmly decided to leave a sports team permanently. They return a team jersey and membership badge to the coach, wearing ordinary clothes and holding a packed personal bag. Serious resolute expression, other teammates watch sadly; the person then walks away from the clubhouse, no smiling daily see-you wave, no captions. Depict a decisive final parting, gentle and nonviolent.

語義・主体・表情・コマ境界を目視確認。場面: Two clear side-by-side panels WITHIN ONE square tile. Left a child accidentally tears a friends drawing, with all torn pieces fully visible on a table and sad faces. Right the child provides the friend a new complete drawing, making up for the damage; happy relieved faces and the ENTIRE replacement sheet including all four corners clearly inside the tile. No picture or paper touches any tile edge. Wide safe margin.
水・ジュース・油が流れる場面を、液と液体の双方の具体例として共有。容器とフライパン全体を含む構図へ再生成。

integration.policy: mainの非重複変更と画像点検画面の機能を維持し、103注文で変更したフィールドと83枚の点検済み画像を統合。噛みやんはmainで削除済みのため再削除しない。
